item.title: K8S AutoScaling in Action: Metrics-Server Aggregation Deployment and HPA Stress-Testing Demystified
item.description: An end-to-end guide to establishing resource metric monitoring and horizontal autoscaling in Kubernetes: from production-ready adaptation of the official metrics-server manifest (secure ports, self-signed TLS certs, scrape interval tuning) and kubectl top verification, to simulating high CPU load with stress, analyzing dynamic HPA scale-out (2→6→10 replicas) and cooldown scale-in, covering both CLI and autoscaling/v2 declarative YAML.
